title: StrategyCritiqueRequest
description: Frozen critic request for the strategy-critique role module (OQ-03 sections 3 and 4). It holds the inputs the model reads; the host-side agent-dispatch/1 carries identity, execution and the result route, and binds this request by its digest. The subject is a registered Strategy Version with its application-owned hash. An unregistered or malformed draft is never dispatched and gets no fabricated hash. Criticism follows registration and precedes evaluation.

CritiqueSubject.title: CritiqueSubject
CritiqueSubject.description: The registered Strategy Version. strategy_hash is the hash the application assigned. A revision carries its parent hash and rule changes in strategy.parent. source_refs and claims are what was recorded with the version, when present.
